snippet.title: Stunted Gravity - Announcement Trailer (PC/Linux)
snippet.description:
Stunted Gravity — hovercraft stunt-driving in shifting gravity.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4103290/Stunted_Gravity/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=coming_soon

Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game set in a neon-dystopian future. Race, jump, and improvise lines across arenas where gravity pulls in any and every direction. Execute stunts, evade hazards, and battle enemy drones as you pilot though the interplanetary Stunted Gravity Circuit.

— — —
Wishlist on Steam (it helps a ton):
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4103290/Stunted_Gravity/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=coming_soon

• Engine: Godot 4 (Forward+, Vulkan)
• Capture: Godot Movie Maker

• Music: Original track
